title: Beef and Broccoli
cook: 5–6 hr on low or 2½–3 hr on high, plus 30 min
total: 5 hr 45 min–6 hr 45 min on low (3 hr 15 min–3 hr 45 min on high)
equipment: Medium saucepan with lid (for the rice)

items: 1½ lb flank steak or boneless chuck, fully thawed, sliced ¼ inch thick against the grain
4 cups broccoli florets (about 1 large head), cut bite-size

steps: Whisk the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and garlic in a 6-quart slow cooker until the sugar dissolves.
Add the beef and stir so every piece is covered by the sauce.
Cover and cook on low 5–6 hr or on high 2½–3 hr, until the beef is tender when pierced with a fork.
In a small bowl, stir the cornstarch into the cold water until smooth. Stir it into the slow cooker along with the broccoli.
Switch to high, cover and cook 20–30 min, until the sauce is thick and glossy and the broccoli is bright green and crisp-tender. Any longer and the broccoli turns mushy.
Meanwhile, cook the rice as the package directs. Serve the beef and broccoli over rice with sesame seeds and scallions.
tips: Freeze the steak 20 min before slicing. Firm meat is much easier to cut thin.
For crisper broccoli, microwave it covered with 2 Tbsp water 3 min and stir it in after the sauce has thickened.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Reheat in the microwave or in a skillet over medium heat until hot. The broccoli softens as it sits, so freezing isn't recommended.
